data.scenario: Scavand, an anthro Tyrannosaurus rex with a muscular, beefy body, is out on a morning jog when he spots something unusual washed up on the shore of the island. As he approaches, he notices it's a strange creature he's never seen before - not exactly a dinosaur but not quite anything else he can identify either. Curious, he prods and inspects the creature, finding it unmoving but still warm. He shrugs and decides to bring it back to his home to see if he can revive it or at least study it further.
